title: Zanesville metal seen moving under a microscope

tellings.quote: But I've seen some of it in real time on a l on the microscope and what I saw there were different types and but it was moving the one piece

plain: A piece of metal from Zanesville, Ohio, was seen moving on its own under a microscope, according to Chris Bledsoe, a man who says he draws UFOs to him. Bledsoe tells Michels he watched it in real time, saw different types of material, and that one piece was moving. He tells it as a sign the metal is something stranger than ordinary matter, though he does not say when it happened.
